newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates La Mondiale claim paying A minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates La Mondiale claim paying A minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had assigned its A minus claims paying ability to La Mondiale Assurance Vie MNDL.PA.

"The rating reflects La Mondiale's sound management and technical expertise, its well established business position in the French long term assurance sector, and its satisfactory capitalisation, reserving and liquidity," S&P said in a statement.
However the rating agency said La Mondiale's modest size in premium terms denies it some of the economies of scale potentially available to larger competitors.
